### Building a New PC – Step‑by‑Step Guide Below is a practical, beginner‑friendly walkthrough. Feel free to skip sections you already know, but keep the order for safety and best results. | # | Task | Key Points | Tips | |---|------|------------|------| | 1 | **Plan & Budget** | • Decide purpose (gaming, workstation, general use).
• Set a budget (CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, case, PSU, peripherals). | Use PCPartPicker to check compatibility and price alerts. | | 2 | **Gather Tools & Workspace** | • Phillips‑head screwdriver (magnetic tip).
• Anti‑static wrist strap or mat.
• Clean, flat surface. | Keep screws organized (different sizes). | | 3 | **Choose Components** | • **CPU** (Intel i5/i7, AMD Ryzen 5/7).
• **Motherboard** (matching socket, chipset).
• **RAM** (DDR4/DDR5, 16 GB minimum).
• **GPU** (if not using integrated graphics).
• **Storage** (NVMe SSD for OS, SATA SSD/HDD for bulk).
• **Case** (ATX mid‑tower, airflow).
• **PSU** (80+ Bronze or better, 500–650 W).
• **Cooling** (stock cooler or aftermarket). | Verify BIOS compatibility (e.g., older boards may need a BIOS update for newer CPUs). | | 4 | **Prepare the Case** | • Remove side panels.
• Install standoffs for motherboard.
• Mount PSU (usually at bottom or top). | Label cables for easier routing later. | | 5 | **Install CPU** | • Open CPU socket latch.
• Align CPU (triangle marker).
• Place gently, lock latch. | Avoid touching pins or pads. | | 6 | **Apply Thermal Paste & Mount Cooler** | • Small pea‑size amount on CPU center.
• Attach cooler, tighten evenly. | If cooler has a fan, connect to CPU fan header. | | 7 | **Insert RAM** | • Open DIMM slots.
• Align notch, press until clicks. | Install in recommended slots (often 1 & 3 for dual‑channel). | | 8 | **Mount Motherboard** | • Align with standoffs and I/O shield.
• Secure with screws. | Double‑check all screws; don’t overtighten. | | 9 | **Install Storage** | • NVMe: slot on motherboard, screw in.
• SATA: mount in drive bay, connect SATA data & power. | Label SATA cables for future reference. | | 10 | **Install GPU** | • Remove expansion slot covers.
• Insert into PCI‑e x16 slot, secure with screw.
• Connect 6‑/8‑pin power from PSU. | Ensure GPU is fully seated; check for any loose connectors. | | 11 | **Connect Power Cables** | • 24‑pin ATX to motherboard.
• 8‑pin EPS to CPU.
• SATA power to drives.
• PCI‑e power to GPU. | Keep cables tidy; use cable ties if needed. | | 12 | **Connect Front Panel** | • USB, audio, power button, reset button, LEDs.
• Refer to motherboard manual for pin layout. | Double‑check orientation; wrong connections can damage components. | | 13 | **Cable Management** | • Route cables behind motherboard tray.
• Use Velcro ties or zip ties. | Good airflow improves cooling and longevity. | | 14 | **First Boot & BIOS Setup** | • Power on, enter BIOS (Del/ F2).
• Check CPU, RAM, storage detection.
• Set boot priority to SSD.
• Enable XMP for RAM. | Save changes before exiting. | | 15 | **Install Operating System** | • Create bootable USB (Windows 10/11, Ubuntu, etc.).
• Boot from USB, install OS on SSD. | Keep drivers handy (motherboard, GPU). | | 16 | **Install Drivers & Updates** | • Motherboard chipset, GPU, Wi‑Fi, audio.
• Windows Update or Linux kernel updates. | Reboot after each major driver install. | | 17 | **Test & Benchmark** | • Run stress tests (Prime95, 3DMark).
• Monitor temperatures (HWMonitor, MSI Afterburner). | Ensure temps stay within safe limits (<80 °C for CPU, <85 °C for GPU). | | 18 | **Final Touches** | • Add peripherals (monitor, keyboard, mouse).
• Install additional fans or RGB lighting if desired. | Keep the system clean; dust filters help. | --- #### Quick Checklist - [ ] CPU + cooler installed - [ ] RAM seated - [ ] Motherboard mounted - [ ] PSU connected - [ ] GPU installed - [ ] Storage connected - [ ] Front panel cables attached - [ ] Cables managed - [ ] BIOS updated & configured - [ ] OS installed - [ ] Drivers updated - [ ] System tested --- #### Common Pitfalls & Fixes | Issue | Likely Cause | Fix | |-------|--------------|-----| | PC doesn’t power on | PSU not connected or faulty | Check PSU switch, cables, try a known‑good PSU | | No display | GPU not seated or power cable loose | Re‑insert GPU, tighten power connector | | BIOS doesn’t detect CPU | Wrong socket or BIOS version | Update BIOS on a compatible board, or use a supported CPU | | Overheating | Poor airflow or insufficient cooling | Add case fans, re‑apply thermal paste, ensure fan orientation | | Random restarts | Power supply under‑rated | Upgrade PSU to higher wattage or better efficiency | --- #### Resources - **PCPartPicker** – component compatibility checker. - **YouTube** – “How to Build a PC” series (e.g., Linus Tech Tips, JayzTwoCents). - **Reddit** – r/buildapc for troubleshooting and advice. - **Manufacturer manuals** – always keep handy for BIOS and cable layouts. Enjoy your new build! If you hit a snag, let me know the exact problem and I’ll help troubleshoot.
message.reasoning: User asks "How to build a new PC?" They want instructions. We can provide a step-by-step guide. No function call needed.
